001package bank.model;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.math.RoundingMode;
005import java.time.LocalDateTime;
006import java.util.UUID;
007
008/**
009 * ============================================================================
010 *  Transaction.java
011 *  Owner: Max Pribac (mpribac@umbc.edu)
012 * ============================================================================
013 *
014 *  WHAT THIS REPRESENTS:
015 *      One single thing happening to one account at one time. Examples:
016 *        - "$200 deposited to CHK-1001 on 2026-04-29 at 10:15"
017 *        - "$50 fee charged on CHK-1001 on 2026-04-30"
018 *
019 *      A TRANSFER produces TWO Transaction records (one TRANSFER_OUT on the
020 *      source, one TRANSFER_IN on the destination).
021 *
022 *  WHO READS THESE:
023 *      - StatementGenerator  — prints them
024 *      - TransactionHistory  — filters them
025 *      - JsonStore           — saves and loads them
026 *
027 *  IMMUTABILITY:
028 *      Once a Transaction is recorded its fields never change. No setters.
029 * ============================================================================
030 */
031public class Transaction {
032
033    private String id;                  // unique UUID
034    private TransactionType type;
035    private String accountId;           // which account this happened on
036    private BigDecimal amount;          // always POSITIVE; type tells direction
037    private LocalDateTime timestamp;
038    private String description;         // short human note
039    private String relatedAccountId;    // for transfers: the OTHER account, else null
040
041    /** No-arg constructor required by Gson. */
042    protected Transaction() { }
043
044    /**
045     * Records a new transaction.
046     *
047     * @param type              the kind of transaction (DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, ...)
048     * @param accountId         the account this happened on
049     * @param amount            the dollar amount (must be positive)
050     * @param description       a short human-readable note
051     * @param relatedAccountId  the other account in a transfer, or null
052     */
053    public Transaction(TransactionType type,
054                       String accountId,
055                       BigDecimal amount,
056                       String description,
057                       String relatedAccountId) {
058        this.id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
059        this.type = type;
060        this.accountId = accountId;
061        this.amount = amount.abs().setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
062        this.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
063        this.description = description;
064        this.relatedAccountId = relatedAccountId;
065    }
066
067    /** Convenience constructor for non-transfer transactions. */
068    public Transaction(TransactionType type, String accountId, BigDecimal amount, String description) {
069        this(type, accountId, amount, description, null);
070    }
071
072    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
073    // Plain getters
074    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
075
076    public String getId() { return id; }
077    public TransactionType getType() { return type; }
078    public String getAccountId() { return accountId; }
079    public BigDecimal getAmount() { return amount; }
080    public LocalDateTime getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
081    public String getDescription() { return description; }
082    public String getRelatedAccountId() { return relatedAccountId; }
083
084    @Override
085    public String toString() {
086        return String.format("[%s] %s %s $%s — %s",
087                timestamp, type, accountId, amount, description);
088    }
089}
